title: trisetum pumilum
intro: Trisetum pumilum, commonly known as dwarf brome or short-bristle brome, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is a perennial grass that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Trisetum pumilum include wound healing, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
